There is a linear scale from 0 to 12,000 on the y-axis, labeled Complaints closed (H2 2019). companies is defined along a categorical scale starting at Aviva Life Services UK Limited and ending at Zurich Assurance Ltd on the x-axis.
caption_L2L3: Aviva and prudential have by far the largest number of complaints.  This is not surprising as these 2 insurance companies must be the largest of those listed. Alternatively Phoenix and Zurich are the companies receiving the smallest number of complaints, explained by their small size.
